semiconductor_relevance: Low — FITOK GmbH primarily supplies valves, fittings, and fluid system solutions, which are not directly related to semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: FITOK GmbH is a global supplier of valves and fittings, specializing in precision instrumentation for various industries, including semiconductor. Their product offerings include integrated systems for fluid control, which can be utilized in semiconductor applications but are not exclusive to the industry.
capabilities: High purity and ultra-high purity products
technical_expertise: Material compatibility for high purity applications
